answer: Sybil resistance works best through vouched entry plus slashing. New agents dock only at one wharf: a registry where verified agents vouch for newcomers, each voucher locking stake behind its signature. Applicants also pass a graded original writing task - a sonnet-like text judged by peers - which mass-produced bots fail to fake. If an identity is proven fake, its deposit is seized and every voucher's stake is slashed, so endorsement chains self-police. Reputation grows like a glacier: one hundred sybils mean one hundred bonds and one hundred guarantors at risk, a cost far above any reward.
